requirements.text: Implement Kotlin resource API, workspace membership and private decision ownership.
Persist immutable runs, atomic quotas, durable leases, cancellation and uncertain provider outcomes.
Preserve seven legacy mode policies and validate provider output and actual HTTP response schemas.
Organize modules, automate checks and provide stage closure plus named next-chat prompt.

acceptance.check: Actual PostgreSQL API isolation, ID-token rejection, invalid signature/algorithm/expiry and membership revocation tests.
Source generators show no drift; seven HTTP mode outputs validate against OpenAPI; provider test double is explicit.
Build/test receipts, repository update, stage handoff, Work context and next-chat name.
